d: At an invitation of trumpets accompanied by musical instruments Attila appears over majestic chariot, pulled by many crowned kings, and slaves, among them evvi to the yoke Theodoric. Alfieri, who explain various, and enemy flags. Soldiers, who carry lights, and bright lights. Vandal army, and Oronte, who invites the trumpets.
Filistene, Attila, Oronte.
Liso leads many chained Prisons among which there are Honoria and Torismondo.
Torismund alone.
Royal Room in Aquileia. Irene. Desba, who survives.
Valentinian comes reading a sheet, he is secus Massimo with a smoking sword of blood.
All alone.
Fortifications of the camp of Attila, in the middle high cadasta. Torismundo, with many, all with faces lit in the right.
Honorary conduct by Liso.
Torismundo sighing, he doesn't look at her.
Irene, Liso, Honoria, Desba.
Attila Royal Pavilion. Attila and Filistene come out.
Liso, Attila, Filistene.
Irene, Attila, Desba.
Attila stays, Irene.
Oronte, sayings.
Valentinian chained.
Irene, Attila, Valentiniano, Massimo.
Maximum with crowned peoples of olive trees, which explain white flags; among which there is a matte of Roman Fighters.
Comes Honoria by rising with live force from the hands of Liso; said.
Royal apartment. Desba followed by Theodoric, and Torismondo.
Theodoric, Torismund, Irene. Desba, who survive.
Honoria, who saw the escape of Torismund, and heard the last verse, follows between himself, Irene, Desba.
In this comes from far away Attila with Valentinian. Honoria, Irene. Desba.
It remains Valentinian, who after staring at Onoria, and she, disdained, follows.
Royal courtyard. Oronte, Filistene, Massimo.
Desba alone.
Theodoric, and Irene hugged, Torismund, Valentinian, Desba.
Irene, Torismondo and Desba remain.
Honoria. Attila with Oronte, who survives.
Honor alone.
Garden of roses with flowers. Oronte. Liso trembling.
Desba, Torismundo.
Irene, who survives.
Irene, Torismundo is not far off.
Irene.
Attila, sayings, then Liso.
Attila takes Irene's hand.
Attila, Filistene, Irene.
Theodoric with bow, and saette, opposite has Torismund from him not seen; said.
They come out from far away Attila, Irene, Valentiniano, Massimo, Oronte, Desba.
Attila with Valentinian, and Irene descend from the throne; Maximus, Theodoric, Oronte, Desba.
Oronte presents to Attila a soldier; sayings.
Desba, Irene.
Everyone leaves alone Irene.
Theodoric, Torismund, Irene.
Grotesque adorned with scales and shells. Massimo, with a team of Vandal Soldiers.
Valentinian, Massimo.
Liso with Honoria. Massimo, Valentinian tied up.
Torismundo survives, while Massimo is in the process of exerting Honoria.
Valentinian, Torismundo.
Valentinian, Torismundo.
Torismund follows Valentinian who disdained part. Honor alone.
Filistene's room. Filistene, sitting down, leaning on a bed, keeps on singing over a small table astrological instruction.
Attila... oronte... filistene lying on the bed.
Liso, and Desba, one from one, the other from another.
Massimo, Attila.
Royal Room. Irene. Theodoric. Torismund and Desba, who come.
Irene, Desba, Attila.
Attila and Irene.
In this come Valentinian, Theodoric, Torismund armed with the sword. Irene.
While Irene embraces Torismundo, sees and hears Honoria that survives, on the side of Attila killed is Oronte, who leads Massimo bound.
